title: Render the mood previews
author: claude
summary: A script renders the room in the morning and afternoon moods from four cameras.
what: A script renders Blender previews of the morning and afternoon moods from four cameras: a, b, c and r.
why: Using the same cameras for each mood makes the moods easy to compare.

tech.name: Cycles
tech.plain: Blender's realistic renderer. It follows light the way a camera would see it.

tech.name: Python scripts
tech.plain: Small programs that tell Blender what to build and bake, so every step can be repeated.
